verified_facts.text: The hotel is at Piazza Augusto Imperatore in the Campo Marzio district of Rome.
verified_facts.excerpt: the new property occupies an illustrious address at Piazza Augusto Imperatore in the heart of the Campo Marzio district

verified_facts.text: The Bvlgari Suite looks out over the Mausoleum of Emperor Augustus.
verified_facts.excerpt: the magnificent Bvlgari Suite, which looks out over the Mausoleum of Emperor Augustus

verified_facts.text: Il Ristorante - Niko Romito is on the fifth floor and has a view over the Mausoleum of Augustus.
verified_facts.excerpt: is located on the fifth floor of the hotel and provides a splendid view over the Mausoleum of the Emperor Augustus

verified_facts.text: The Bvlgari Bar has a black marble bar top finished with 110 Murano glass twirls hand blown with gold dust by Barovier&Toso.
verified_facts.excerpt: The sumptuous black marble bar top is finished with 110 Murano glass twirls that are hand blown with gold dust by Barovier&Toso.

verified_facts.text: The Bvlgari Bar has an outside bar and two terraces, one onto Via di Ripetta and one onto Piazza Augusto Imperatore.
verified_facts.excerpt: For fine weather there is an outside bar and two large terraces, one that looks onto Via di Ripetta, and the other onto Piazza Augusto Imperatore.

verified_facts.text: The Bvlgari Spa evokes ancient Roman baths, with marble columns rising from the swimming pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: the Bvlgari Spa evokes the atmosphere of ancient Roman baths, with marble columns that rise from the swimming pool

verified_facts.text: The spa treatments are designed by Augustinus Bader.
verified_facts.excerpt: Exclusive spa treatments are designed by Augustinus Bader.

verified_facts.text: The spa has a Spa Suite with a green onyx bath.
verified_facts.excerpt: a state-of-the-art Spa Suite featuring a green onyx bath

verified_facts.text: Il Caffe, on the ground floor, was the first cafe created by Niko Romito.
verified_facts.excerpt: Il Caffè, the first of its kind in Italy and the first created by Niko Romito

verified_facts.text: The private dining room has walls upholstered in Rubelli fabric depicting the twelve signs of the Zodiac.
verified_facts.excerpt: Walls are upholstered in fabric from Rubelli, a historic Italian textile maker, and depict the twelve signs of the Zodiac

verified_facts.text: The rooms are divided into four colour palettes: white, yellow, red and green.
verified_facts.excerpt: divided into four color palates; white, yellow, red, and green.

verified_facts.text: The Magnificent Path, an exclusive walking tour of Rome, begins at the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: the Magnificent Path begins at the Bvlgari Hotel Roma

verified_facts.text: The hotel has a library dedicated to the history of jewellery.
verified_facts.excerpt: library dedicated to the history of jewellery

verified_facts.text: The Lobby Lounge is reserved for hotel guests throughout the day.
verified_facts.excerpt: the Lobby Lounge is reserved for hotel guests throughout the day

verified_facts.text: Chef Niko Romito's menu reinvents contemporary Italian cuisine in a concept developed exclusively for Bvlgari Hotels & Resorts.
verified_facts.excerpt: the menu reinvents contemporary Italian cuisine in a concept that has been developed exclusively for Bvlgari Hotels & Resorts
